Players Committee card image of [[Jabba's Sail Barge (V)]] (original printing), game text: “May add 1 alien driver and 8 passengers. Your vehicle weapons deploy free aboard. Once per turn, may deploy Passenger Deck or a skiff here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While on Tatooine with a skiff, Force drain +1 here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/jabbassailbarge.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
